title: The Boy Samuel Ministered
text: And the boy Samuel ministered to the LORD before Eli.

title: The Word of the LORD Was Rare
text: Now in those days the word of the LORD was rare, and visions were scarce.

title: Eli's Eyesight Was Dim
text: And at that time Eli, whose eyesight had grown so dim that he could not see, was lying in his room.

title: The Lamp of God
text: Before the lamp of God had gone out, Samuel was lying down in the temple of the LORD …

title: Where the Ark of God Was
text: … where the ark of God was located.

title: Here I Am
text: Then the LORD called to Samuel, and he answered, “Here I am.”

title: I Did Not Call
text: I did not call, | Go back and lie down.

title: Once Again
text: Once again the LORD called, “Samuel!”

title: My Son
text: My son, I did not call, | Go back and lie down.

title: Samuel Did Not Yet Know the LORD
text: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, because the word of the LORD had not yet been revealed to him.

title: The Third Time
text: Once again, for the third time, the LORD called to Samuel.

title: Eli Realized
text: Then Eli realized that it was the LORD who was calling the boy.

title: Speak, LORD
text: … and if He calls you, say, ‘Speak, LORD, for Your servant is listening.’

title: Samuel! Samuel!
text: Then the LORD came and stood there, calling as before, “Samuel! Samuel!”

title: Your Servant Is Listening
text: Speak, for Your servant is listening.

title: Ears Will Tingle
text: I am about to do something in Israel at which the ears of all who hear it will tingle.

title: The Judgment on Eli's House
text: On that day I will carry out against Eli everything I have spoken about his house, from beginning to end.

title: Afraid to Tell Eli
text: He was afraid to tell Eli the vision …

title: What Was the Message?
text: What was the message He gave you? | Do not hide it from me.

title: He Did Not Hide a Thing
text: So Samuel told him everything and did not hide a thing from him.

title: He Is the LORD
text: “He is the LORD,” replied Eli. “Let Him do what is good in His eyes.”

title: None of His Words Fell
text: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and He let none of Samuel’s words fall to the ground.

title: A Prophet of the LORD
text: So all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew that Samuel was confirmed as a prophet of the LORD.

title: The LORD Continued to Appear
text: And the LORD continued to appear at Shiloh, because there He revealed Himself to Samuel by His word.

title: My Sheep Listen to My Voice
text: My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.

title: Visions Were Scarce
text: Now in those days the word of the LORD was rare, and visions were scarce.

title: He Opened the Doors
text: Samuel lay down until the morning; then he opened the doors of the house of the LORD.
